question.knowledge_point: Finding a Difference of Sets Using a Venn Diagram
question.worked_solution:
The difference $T∖S$ consists of all the elements that are in $T$ but not $S.$ To represent $T∖S,$ we will shade in all the area that is contained in $T$ but not $S.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071857/assets/c718918667c5076f8696ea98f453ff17f005d5f7cace87bd863be309fac28d72.png)

The elements $t,e,$ and $l$ are in $T$ but not $S.$

Therefore, the difference is

$$
T∖S={t,e,l}.
$$
